messages:
Nina: Quick flag  found a mismatch between the JSON Schema examples in the function-calling guide and the SDK enum validator. Example shows 'low|medium|high' but the SDK accepts 'low','med','high'. Docs PR failing validation on downstream tests. Can we align ASAP?

Harold: ugh, thanks. Which file path? I can take the docs side if it's just wording.

Nina: docs/function-calling/json-schema-examples.json and the migration guide that links to it. Also one internal link in the guide points to an old internal draft (403)  schema-bot flagged it.

Jae: should we change the example to show the canonical SDK values and add a tiny conversion paragraph that maps human-friendly enums to SDK enums? That avoids breaking readers who assume verbose labels.

schema-bot: ci/schema-checker failed: example enum values do not match validator mapping (expected: med not medium). Broken link: https://internal.redwood.ai/drafts/enum-mappings (403).

Molly: I can update examples to use the SDK canonical enums and add a small table: human -> sdk. Also add a code snippet showing mapping in both Python and TS. Example mapping snippet: 
```js
const map = { low: 'low', medium: 'med', high: 'high' };
const payload = { severity: map[userLabel] };
```

Harold: on tests  I'll add a docs-runner check that loads the JSON example and runs the SDK validator to ensure parity. One assert: validatedPayload.severity in ['low','med','high'].

Jae: good. Also propose adding a short JSONSchema example for a union that allows both the envelope and the legacy array form (for backward compatibility) and a clear deprecation note. That'll reduce support noise during the rollout.

schema-bot: note: permitting both shapes in schema increases ambiguity; recommend a migration timeline note if we accept both.

Molly: I'll host the fixed example under /docs/examples/function-calling/3971112222-enum-canonical.json and update the guide link to https://docs.redwood.ai/examples/function-calling/3971112222-enum-canonical.json so the link-checker is happy.

Harold: action items: 1) Molly: update example JSON + mapping paragraph + code snippets; 2) Harold: add docs-runner validator test in infra/docs-tests; 3) Jae: add union-schema example and deprecation note in the migration guide; 4) Nina: update PR description and include changelog blurb.

Molly: opened docs PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4499  includes new example and a small table. Left a TODO to add the union-schema after Jae drops it.

Harold: infra PR for docs-runner test: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/834 (draft). It runs the SDK validator against the new example.

build-bot: ci/docs-link-checker fixed previous external link after update. Running full docs-ci.

Jae: pushed union-schema example and migration note in a follow-up commit to the docs branch. Also added a tiny snippet showing how to convert legacy arrays to the envelope shape using a helper.

Nina: thanks all. Can we aim to merge before the next docs release? This one tends to confuse customers.

Molly: aiming to get green CI in the next hour, then we'll merge. Will ping here when done.

Harold: CI passing locally, waiting on infra job.

build-bot: infra/docs-tests passed; docs CI still running.

Molly: merged and updated the migration guide. Changelog entry: "Clarified enum values and added migration mapping; union form temporarily supported, v2 will enforce envelope-only."

Nina: awesome  closing loop. Please file a follow-up to add an evals golden example so we catch semantic mapping regressions later.

Jae: filed evals issue: https://github.com/redwood/evals/issues/155 linking back to this thread.

Nina: :rocket:
